fields.name: feedUrl
fields.label: GTFS-Realtime feed
fields.description: The agency's GTFS-Realtime TripUpdates feed (.pb), from any country: mobilitydatabase.org lists them. The frame downloads it itself and keeps only your stops: a feed of any size on FrameOS 2026.11.15 or later; before that, on an ESP32, only one under 512 KB.

fields.name: feedHeader
fields.label: Feed header
fields.description: Optional: a header the feed asks for, such as x-api-key: your-key.

fields.name: stop
fields.label: Stop
fields.description: The stop_id the feed uses, from the agency's GTFS stops.txt: a platform's id, several with commas. A name of your own goes before an equals sign, or the board says the first id.

fields.name: stop2
fields.label: Second stop
fields.description: Optional: another stop, shown beside the first, written the same way.

fields.name: lines
fields.label: Lines
fields.value:

fields.description: A feed has times but no names: one route a line, route_id | name | color | toward (direction 0) | toward (direction 1). Routes not listed show their route_id.

fields.name: walk
fields.label: Walk to the stop (minutes)
fields.description: Departures sooner than this are left out: you would not make them.

fields.name: only
fields.label: Only these lines
fields.description: Optional: line names as the board shows them, with commas.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

transitBoard.name: Transit departures (GTFS-Realtime, any country)
transitBoard.description: Departures from any agency's GTFS-Realtime TripUpdates feed, read on the frame, as a station board for one or two stops.
